correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts every exponent partition compatible with Omega at most five. One-prime support gives exactly prime squares. On multiple-prime support, exponents all at most two make B strictly smaller than beta squared, so an exponent at least three is forced. The only remaining three-prime and two-prime exponent patterns are eliminated by exact modular and inequality arguments. The witness 144 verifies sharpness. The finite replay is corroborative only.
